summary: Tidewater Inc. filed an 8-K updating its pending acquisition of Wilson Sons Ultratug Participações S.A. and Atlantic Offshore Services S.A. from Wilson Sons S.A., Ultranav International II, S.A., and Remolcadores Ultratug Limitada. Tidewater will pay $500 million on a debt-free, cash-free basis, subject to adjustments including assumption of approximately $239.7 million in target debt as of March 31, 2026. All local regulatory approvals, including from the Brazilian Antitrust Authority, have been obtained, and required change-of-control waivers under credit facilities have been secured. The parties are finalizing remaining closing documentation and now expect the transaction to close in Q3 2026. Watch for further updates on closing conditions and any deal-related risks.
